These two files must end up at this exact path in your repository:

    .github/workflows/update.yml      (the hourly data download)
    .github/workflows/pages.yml       (publishing; skip it if your Pages site already works)

GitHub only runs them from a folder named ".github" (with the dot). Your computer hides
dot-folders, so this zip uses a visible folder name. Choose either way to add them:

WAY 1 (recommended, 1 minute): paste as a new file
  1. In your repository on GitHub click  Add file -> Create new file
  2. In the name box type:   .github/workflows/update.yml
     (as you type each "/" GitHub turns it into a folder)
  3. Open update.yml from this zip in any text editor, select all, copy, paste into GitHub's editor
  4. Commit changes

WAY 2: upload, then move
  1. Add file -> Upload files -> drag the whole "github-workflows" folder in -> Commit
  2. Open github-workflows/update.yml on GitHub, click the pencil (Edit)
  3. Click into the filename box at the top. Press Backspace until the "github-workflows/" part
     disappears, then type:  .github/workflows/update.yml
  4. Commit changes. Repeat for pages.yml if you need it, then delete the empty github-workflows folder.

AFTER ADDING (required once)
  Settings -> Actions -> General -> Workflow permissions -> "Read and write permissions" -> Save
  Actions tab -> "Update gold data" -> Run workflow
  A green run means the CSV is now updated to the current hour, and it will repeat every hour.
